name: Jan Ciągliński
findings: Uses linen grey 4.7x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 694 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, honey yellow turns up as a small accent in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 2.3x the archive's rate (from 694 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, slate grey turns up as the lightest note in 67% of the paintings that hold it, 2.3x the archive's rate (from 694 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, mikado brown turns up as the shadow in 67% of the paintings that hold it, 6.8x the archive's rate (from 694 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 694 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 694 paintings here).
Pairs graphite violet with purple slate more than chance would predict (3 of 694 paintings here).
Pairs coffee with nut brown more than chance would predict (3 of 694 paintings here).
